title: NK306 BGT corn (NK306): Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: NK306 BGT corn: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: NK306 BGT corn is a yellow GM hybrid corn variety for Mindanao. About 103 days to harvest, 10.8 t/ha in trials. See its ratings and traits.
excerpt: NK306 BGT corn is a yellow GM hybrid corn variety, also sold or known as NK306 or NK306 Bt/GT. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council (NSIC) in 2021 as NSIC 2021 GMCn 77. Syngenta Crop Protection AG bred it. It takes about 103 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain, with 10.82 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: If you came here looking for NK306 or NK306 Bt/GT, this is the same corn. The facts below come from the NSIC registry kept by the Bureau of Plant Industry, with notes from its seller and farm sources. Compare it with the others in our [corn variety finder](/crop-varieties/corn), or see [every crop variety](/crop-varieties) we list. For the crop itself, read our guide: [Pagtatanim ng mais, step by step](/crops/pagtatanim-ng-mais).

blocks.text: Key facts about NK306 BGT corn

blocks.caption: From the NSIC registry and its seller

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

NK306 BGT corn takes about 103 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. That is about the average of the 89 yellow GM hybrid corn varieties with a day count, 105.4 days. A shorter crop frees the field sooner and dodges more of the weather, while a longer one often fills more.

Its average yield of 10.82 t/ha beats the average of its group, 8.13. It sits in the top quarter of its group. One tonne of shelled corn fills about 20 sacks of 50 kilograms. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing. Its seller gives about 103 (wet season) in NSIC trials.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.
Is it resistant to pests and diseases?

blocks.caption: Reactions in the registry trials, rated under natural field conditions

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting. Read up on [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer).

The pests and diseases that hit corn fields most often: [Asian corn borer](/pests/asian-corn-borer), [banded leaf and sheath blight](/diseases/banded-leaf-and-sheath-blight), [Corn downy mildew](/diseases/corn-downy-mildew), [Corn ear rot](/diseases/corn-ear-rot), [Corn earworm](/pests/corn-earworm). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.
Its ears grew about 18.5 cm long in the trials. The shelling recovery was 77.69 percent, the share of the ear weight that comes off as grain. A higher share means more grain from every sack of ears.
What its seller and farm sources say

items: **Yield:** Up to 12 t/ha (company), 14.82 t/ha at DA 10's Claveria hillyland station (about 966 m above sea level), NSIC trials averaged 10.82 t/ha in Mindanao.
**Traits in the seed:** BGT (built in caterpillar protection plus glyphosate tolerance) per the DA derby names.
**Where:** DA trials in the Bukidnon and Claveria highlands (600 to 966 m).
Big, well filled ears with good grain.

blocks.text: Why farmers know it: top yielder (14.82 t/ha) at DA Northern Mindanao's March 2022 derby at the Claveria hillyland station, and Syngenta's best entry (9.09 t/ha) in DA 10's dry season derby round. These are the seller's own figures, from its own trials. So plant a small area first, and compare it with your usual corn on the same ground.
Where and when to plant NK306 BGT corn

The registry recommends it for Mindanao. Start with the color your buyer pays for: yellow corn goes to feed mills, while white and glutinous corn go to the table. Next, pick between a hybrid, which yields more but needs new seed every season, and an open pollinated variety, whose seed you can save. Then match the island group in its recommendation, because trials in Luzon and Mindanao give different winners. Before planting, get the field ready with our guide: [Land preparation for corn](/land-preparation/corn-land-preparation).

items.q: Is NK306 the same as NK306 BGT?
items.a: Yes. NK306 is another name for NK306 BGT, registered as NSIC 2021 GMCn 77. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes about 103 days from planting to the harvest of dry grain. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 10.82 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.
No. It is a hybrid, so seed saved from it does not grow true and yields less. Buy new seed each season.
The registry recommends it for Mindanao. Ask your municipal agriculturist how it has done in your town.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of NK306 BGT?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
